visual_review.notes: Both complete original faces show Champion Unit, Kha'Zix / The Void, 4 Energy, 1 Chaos Power, 4 Might, Ambush and identical attack/defend instructions. Only the base face prints the italic Ambush reminder. The enemy must be alone; Kha'Zix may have friendly company.
